summary: The Google.org Generative AI Accelerator page now lists the selected 2025 recipients. That call is no longer an open application; no next general GenAI call was confirmed.

sources.title: Google.org GenAI Accelerator recipients
sources.supports: Selected 2025 recipients, $30M total program support and six-month assistance.

notes: A recipients announcement confirms a completed selection, not that Google.org has permanently discontinued accelerators.
Do not present the former 2025 deadline as current.
